findings.explanation: Lean uses `∃ v ty` where HOL4 uses `∀ v ty`. Take an empty type signature and a membership relation that is always false. In Lean, any variable name and the type `Tyapp (mls "missing") []` witness the existential because that type fails `type_ok`. In HOL4, every `Tyvar` passes `type_ok`, so the universal condition requires a membership fact that is false.
findings.repair: ∀ v ty, type_ok tysig ty → mem (σ (v, ty)) (typesem δ τ ty)
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics

open Candle

example (ts : tysig) (bad : type) (hbad : ¬ type_ok ts bad)
    (δ : tyass Unit) (τ : tyval Unit) (σ : tmval Unit) :
    is_term_valuation0 (fun _ _ => False) ts δ τ σ := by
  exact ⟨mls "x", bad, fun h => hbad h⟩
